claims: Anthropic publishes over a dozen self-paced courses, every one free with a certificate at the end
AI Fluency is about four hours and is 'the core'
Course creators charge hundreds for the same AI fundamentals
The first two courses (Claude 101 + AI Fluency) are 'the whole game for most people'
how_to_steps: Go to Claude Academy (Anthropic's free education site)
If new, take Claude 101 (short, ~1 hr) to get comfortable with the tool
Take AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations (~4 hr): what to hand off, how to describe what you want, how to judge what comes back
Pick your lane: students/educators/nonprofits versions, or the developer track (Claude Code 101, Claude Platform 101, subagents, agent skills, Cowork, Claude API) if you write code
on_screen_only: Claude Academy header: 'Learn to use AI safely, effectively, and with intention. Free courses, tutorials, and use cases from Anthropic's education team.'
'Go deeper with Anthropic courses — Structured learning paths with video lessons and assessments to help you master AI collaboration, Claude development, and MCP'

AI Fluency 'What you'll learn' list: Explain what AI Fluency means; Apply the 4D framework of Delegation, Description, Discernment, and Diligence; Distinguish Automation, Augmentation, and Agency; Describe how generative AI and LLMs work incl. capabilities and limitations; Make strategic Delegation decisions using Problem/Platform/Task Awareness; Communicate clearly through Product, Process, and Performance Description and foundational prompting; Evaluate outputs via the Description-Discernment loop; Practice Creation, Transparency, and Deployment Diligence
